translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yon wok ban bomin kinim gebom wakadu anbisiw sung uta ko.
Kanaba am dánámin kabadákal Edot ayo Galili bakan gawman kamok kei be kale aka Yesus kanam kába sung uyo kidi nadayo

bude alam wok fakudin kinim bakoyam, “kinima, bela Yon wok ban bomin kinim namti, kal talá tabe bom nada kanam kábane! Kano bom nadano emak dubat so keimin kitid dukum uyo tad kiwa daubuno.” Yakeisa ko.
Kata suwayo Edot ayo Yon dew faku dawo kalabus am dawtisa uyo wataw kalan bá, ning Filiw ami kadel Edoddias uyo takidawsa,
kayo Yon ayo Edot bakodaw, “kaba ning kadel uyo kudusaw uyo kukuw kidel bá.” Akanbisa, kayo
Edot aka Yon wok ban bomin kinim ayo anbidono, kalsa. Kata aka kinim wanang itam fingon dása uyo watawo kaleyo bá, wanang kinim ika Yon be afan lum senin kinimo, kale aket kudawsiw kayo ko.
Kata Edot alami dausu am dánámin tadune, alam fol wan bom kei bidiwe Edoddias umi mun uyo kinim tem kadákal itol fakel dá buduyo, Edot ayo utam aket wananlaw sudu si,
Got dawsonu nadale kala ka. “Naka yaknámin so mak kunamo, kale nadaw dákadálokabaw, naka kukamongin kuw keidokabi.”
Kalane, wanang mát ulumi akun aket fukanin mak bakomamune, uka Edot bakodaw, “kala kamano Yon wok ban bomin kinim gebom uyo wakadu wom sabat ifo kunamo.” Akune,

kamok ayo wanin wanbiw kadákal weng abem mak kuti bako nadale uka utaw so kanamalo kalu, naka kumamongin kuwo kaleba, kayo aket keidawu mikabusi nadale bako, “kalo ulum kanodono, kalbu uyo kumamin kala.”
Kale nadale kinim mak dabadála yak kalabus am Yon gebom wakadu
nadale wom sabat dim kuti kudew tad wanang mát damane uta tabe kudew tad akun damamsu kala.
Kale Yon alam kinim iyo Yon dam uyo kudu nadiwe dau dabadá yak ika yak Yesus bakodawsiw ko.
Yesus 5,000 kinim wanin akiwsa sung uta ko.

Kale Yesus ayo kanomin weng sung uyo kidi nadale kabadák bu kudá alam tudon kunu kudew anang iwán sed gisa bakan mak unane wanang kinim ika kidilomo kal unbano, kale nadiwade ika ilim abiw abiw kalo kudá yán leiw am ibik tem ei bidiw,
Yesus akal yak wok madik dák bakan tod nadale kanomin wanang kinim seng seng bidi itam nadale aket budunláwane, aka imi asanin uyo im kidel dáka bom keimsa.

Kale am makuw dánámin kabadák ki bi kuinane, alam weng kidimin kinim iyo tad nadiwade bakodaw, “kawta, be dák anang iwán sed gisa bakan ade am kuinba ade imin tew kale kaba wakal imadálawo yak abiw abiw ká bom nadiwo ilim wanin mak mo wanino!” Akiwe,
Yesus asik weng atung fakadu bakoyam, “ika unodiw báyo, kiwta wanin mak dauyamiw, wanino!”
Kalane, ika bakodiw, “kuina, nuka mada budet kim auok kal mak ade takam alew kuw mada kuwo.” Akiwe,
aka bakoyam, “á be fako dew tadino!” Yakei nadane

aka wanang kinim bakoyam, “adikum dák badasal dim tein fakadálino.” Yakei nadale beta aka budet katiw auok kal sino takam alew kuw sino uyo kudu faku nadale katam fen abid tikin kin mo nadale aka Got ken keiyo, akbane, budet kim uyo kudu fakel fakel ku nadane alam weng kidimin kinim kuyamane, weng kidimin kinim ita tabe wanang kinim wak geleyamiwe,
ika wanbi galyamane, weng kidimin kinim iyo wanin madik kudáliw uyo men kilung kal abudiw weinsu ko.
Kale kinim wanin wanesiw bidi ding bako 5000 kinim, kata wanangá maná bidi ding bakodongin dakosiw ko.
Yesus wok dang kun dim tod tod kámsa sung uta ko.
Kale kanabiw kabadákal wabising Yesus ayo alam weng kidimin kinim bakoyam, “kiwsik gebom yak wok madik unino. Yakei, imadála kunu tem isik uniwe, aka wanang kinim kanomin iyo imbakadála uniw ka.
Kale nadale yanol alafin amgu tikin tam Alaw suksuklawono kale una. Kale akal alafin tam kal kuina suksuk bom tein bada,
alam weng kidimin kinim itane kunu kudew un bi yak wok iwyak uniwe, taufed kutad kunu dádu wok mik fikmin fakmon tabu gedul man fukan kutad kunu dádu kinim abuduno kanam tad bidiw bi
am fadena de weng tabe tadule Yesus ayo yak itamon kale wok dang dim tod tod ilim finang tad bom keimane,

alam weng kidimin kinim iyo atamomo wok dang kun dim be kinim mak tod tod tadba ka. Kale nadiwade ika kun banbin dok teiyama wadwad sawsaw bom fingán bom nadiwe ika bakodiw, “kuin sawkal memako kal bom fingániwe.”
Yesus aka wabising weng bakoyam, “atud fakadá teinino, nalta bo, fingánin bá.” Yakane,
beta Bita ayo weng atung fakadu gán dádaw, “kawta, atin afan kabalata namti, nalatano, nakawo wok dang kun dim tod tod yak katamono.” Akane,
Kamokim Yesus ayo bakodaw, “tadalo, nalta bo.” Akane, afan Bita ayo kunu kudá dák wok kumun abe tod nadale tod tod Yesus atama.
Kata aka taufed kanabu uyo utam nadale fingán bom nadale wok wak tam dá kilanongin keimi ka. Kale nadale, “kuino kuino, Kamokim Yesus dakonamal dakonamal!” Akan tabane,
Yesus ayo wabising teng fudut yak dew faku nadale bakodaw, “bu ka! Kaba aket afano kalin katiw. Watawo kaleyo aket aket tabebáwe?” Akane,
beta alew ika fal matam kunu dim tadiwe taufed uyo kimi kalune,
beta kunu tem tein fakadábiw iyo Yesus win kufádaw bom nadiwe bakodiw, “atin afan kabayo ki Got alam man adik dáwo.” Aksiw ko.
Kale beta wok yakan dá yak Genesadet bakan unsiw.
Kale kabadák kinim iyo atamomane, Yesus alata ka. Kale nadiwade weng kudáliw yak bakan kabadák ulum mewso mewso biyámin unune,

wanang kinim iyo asanin gam gam kinim iyo fabudu imadew tad dakádaw bom nadiwade ika munlaw bom kaliw, “nuka ufek ufek dukum dákadákamokabuw bá, kata ufek ufek katiw mada kuw dákadákamokabuw. Kale kaba imadálawo, ikil ilita yak ilim kinang ki malekam bom kidelanino.” Akeisiw ko.
